Package httyd.model.dragon

Enum Class DragonClass

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<DragonClass>
httyd.model.dragon.DragonClass
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<DragonClass>, Constable
public enum DragonClass extends Enum<DragonClass>
The seven dragon classes from the "How to Train Your Dragon" universe. Each class has a display name and a theme colour used by the GUI.
